title: Convert retained-address hazards into finite-chain fidelity without confusing exposure and log loss
statement: For a>0, b_k>=0 and L>=1, B_j=sum_(k=1)^j b_k, F_L=product_(j=0)^(L-1)(1+B_j/a)^(-1). The exact exposure identity is S_L=sum_(k=1)^(L-1)(L-k)b_k/a. If b_k=b_1*k^(-alpha) with fixed b_1/a>0, the alpha0/1/>1 cases have quadratic, L log L and linear exposure order respectively; S_L is not itself -log F_L.

requires: Integer L>=1, a>0, finite b_k>=0 and independent memoryless competing clocks within each correctly reached stage.
B_j is irreversible wrong joining; consistent stage reset/conditional rates and no omitted damage, correction or other absorbing outcomes.
provides: For a>0, b_k>=0 and L>=1, B_j=sum_(k=1)^j b_k, F_L=product_(j=0)^(L-1)(1+B_j/a)^(-1). The exact exposure identity is S_L=sum_(k=1)^(L-1)(L-k)b_k/a. If b_k=b_1*k^(-alpha) with fixed b_1/a>0, the alpha0/1/>1 cases have quadratic, L log L and linear exposure order respectively; S_L is not itself -log F_L.
assumptions: Exposure S_L is not exact log loss; controlled linearization needs small hazards. For alpha>1 both have linear order at fixed rates, generally with different coefficients.
A claimed polymer exponent is not an acquired contact/recruitment law for this relay.
costs: Pay actual positional recruitment rates, every stage and full root/product survival; linear exposure is not free long-chain reliability.
contract.units: a,b_k,b,r_esc,d_A,x,d_T are inverse-time rates. L,j,k count additions or retained sites; alpha and S_L dimensionless. Distance index k and escape rate r_esc are distinct. F_L/P_j are conditional model probabilities, not measured yield, starting-root recovery or throughput.
contract.obstruction: Acquire the physical positional hazard and distinguish finite-chain probability from an exposure approximation.

body: At each correctly reached stage, a race between intended rate a and actual irreversible wrong rate B_j succeeds with a/(a+B_j); multiply the conditional stage probabilities under the declared reset/rate model. Interchange finite sums to obtain S_L. For alpha0, S_L=(b_1/a)*L*(L-1)/2; for alpha1, S_L=(b_1/a)*(L*H_(L-1)-(L-1)); for alpha>1 it lies between(b_1/a)*(L-1) and(b_1/a)*L*(1+1/(alpha-1)). For u_j=B_j/a, 0<=S_L-(-log F_L)<=sum_j u_j^2/2, so the exposure approximation is controlled when all hazards are small. Curator diagnostic a=b_1=1,alpha0,L3 gives F_L=1/6 and S_L=3; e^3>6 already follows from three Taylor terms, so they are not the same log loss. Since B_j>=b_1 for j>=1, F_L<=(1+b_1/a)^(-(L-1)): summable contact interference still loses long-chain fidelity at fixed positive rates. The ideal-coil exponent and1024-step numerical screen are supplied hypotheses/reports, not acquired rates or yields.

evidence.range_scope: Written irreversible positional-hazard product and accumulated-exposure scalings; no measured polymer contact law or accepted numerical chain yield.

Reconstructed the two-state first-step absorption equations and the lossless renewal mean, with explicit positive escape/nondegeneracy requirements. Exact Fraction checks exercise finite products/harmonic sums, two-state linear systems, lossless means, zero-escape failure and reversible-capture versus irreversible-error counterexamples. Small algebraic diagnostics are curator checks, not producer Monte Carlo/ODE replay or measured chemistry. Deduplication recovers the absorption probability from earlier U1025-retained-product-diversion under k=a,w=d_A,x_old=x+d_T,h=lambda=0,r=r_esc, preserving correct-versus-failure probability only. Its old lossless detour count also gives the residence-time refinement after paying mean1/r_esc per trap plus active L/a. This is explicit reuse, not an independent new absorption theorem; wrong-versus-dead labels and complete dynamics are not preserved by that coarsening.
